name: Cards
description: Colourful note cards in a grid, like a sticky-note board: pin, colours, pictures, checklists, bold / italic / strikethrough / underline (buttons, or Ctrl/Cmd+B, +I, +U, +Shift+X), archive and bin. Turn a whole page into a board from the ⋯ menu, or type ```cards in a note.
tagline: Sticky-note cards, right in your notes
author: Granite
